name: Finesse
author: CoffeeCC
description: Finesse for Jellyfin in the Omarchy bar: Continue Watching at a glance, one click to resume.

barWidget.description: Continue Watching from your Jellyfin server. Click a title to resume it in Finesse.

schema.label: Finesse URL
schema.description: Where your Finesse client is served, e.g. https://media.example.com/finesse

schema.label: Jellyfin URL
schema.description: Jellyfin server address. Leave blank to use the Finesse URL's origin.

schema.label: Jellyfin API key
schema.description: Dashboard > API Keys. Stored in plain text in shell.json.

schema.label: Jellyfin user
schema.description: Whose Continue Watching to show. Blank = first user on the server.
